units.text: Aspose.Slides FOSS for Java reads and writes Office Open XML presentation files with the .pptx extension. It creates and modifies slides, shapes, text, connectors, comments, notes slides, and document properties inside the presentation package. It builds the Office Open XML package itself, so it needs no PowerPoint installation, no native code, and no runtime dependencies at all — the CycloneDX SBOM the build produces lists zero components.
It creates and edits presentations by instantiating the Presentation class, adding or removing slides through SlideCollection methods, and saving the result in PPTX, PPSX, or POTX format.

It adds and formats shapes including rectangles, connectors, and tables by calling ShapeCollection methods such as addAutoShape, addConnector, and addTable, then configures their fill, line, and position properties.
It formats text content at the portion, paragraph, and text frame level using PortionFormat, ParagraphFormat, and TextFrameFormat to control font height, bold style, fill color, and alignment.

It applies visual effects such as outer shadow, glow, and blur to shapes by enabling effect types through EffectFormat and configuring their parameters like blur radius, direction, distance, and color.

It manages slides and comments by cloning or inserting slides via SlideCollection methods and adding threaded comments with author, text, position, and timestamp through CommentAuthor and CommentCollection.

It embeds images and adds speaker notes by loading image data into ImageCollection, attaching images to slides with addPictureFrame, and writing notes text to a slide's NotesSlide through NotesSlideManager.
This example creates a new presentation, clears the first slide, adds a solid blue rectangle shape, and saves the result as a PPTX file.

The following workflows demonstrate creating connectors, adding comments, setting document properties, applying effects, adding speaker notes, cloning slides, saving to streams, formatting text, and creating tables.
Create a connector between two shapes.
Add a threaded comment to a slide.
Set document properties on a presentation.
Apply an outer shadow effect to a shape.
Add speaker notes to a slide.
Clone a slide within a presentation.
Save a presentation to an in-memory stream.
Format a text portion's font size, weight, and color.
Create a table and set cell text.

The primary entry point is Presentation, which owns an ISlideCollection of Slide objects; each slide exposes an IShapeCollection of Shape-derived objects (AutoShape, Connector, Table, PictureFrame) built through ShapeCollection's addAutoShape(), addConnector(), addTable(), and addPictureFrame() methods. It reads and writes presentations in PowerPoint formats and supports shapes, text, comments, and effects.
The org package namespace hosts the top-level packages for Aspose.Slides FOSS for Java, including org.aspose and org.aspose.slides.
The org.aspose package namespace contains core types shared across Aspose products, with org.aspose.slides providing the presentation-specific API.
The org.aspose.slides package namespace provides the complete API for working with presentations, including Presentation, ISlide, IShapeCollection, and all shape types.
The getFontName method is part of the text formatting API and retrieves the name of the font used for a text portion.
The Relationship class represents relationships between parts in a presentation package, supporting package-level navigation and metadata.
